errors.evidence: The largest sector, colored yellow, corresponds to 'по-малко от 10,' not 'никога.'
Description states the largest sector as 57.1% (for 'никога'), but it is actually the yellow sector representing 'по-малко от 10.'
Description states that the second largest sector is 26.2%, but that value represents the yellow sector, not 'между 10 и 20.'
The description fails to mention that the blue sector ('20 или повече') is quantified and exists in the chart.
The description lacks information about the numerical value for the blue and gray sectors.
